entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: Zendikar merfolk trickster god of the realms of land and earth, the forbidden god, born of memories of Kozilek.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: Eldrazi whose long-lost memories are the source of Cosi and Talib.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: People who know the earth god as Talib.

entities.name: Tricksters
entities.description: Elusive group who secretly worshipped Cosi.

relations.note: Cosi and Talib come from Kozilek's long-lost memories.
relations.quote: come from the same source: long-lost memories of the terrible Eldrazi Kozilek
